entities.name: Banana Economy and the John Compton Era
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Bananas replaced sugar and cacao as Saint Lucia's primary export, benefiting from preferential access to the British market under the Commonwealth banana regime. John Compton emerged as the dominant political figure, leading Saint Lucia through associated statehood (1967) and later to independence.
